providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26): New Horizons imaged Kerberos only distantly during its single 2015 flyby, enough to reveal a double-lobed shape but not a global photomosaic. Procedural texture: bright neutral base with light cratering, same treatment as its 3 sibling small moons (real >50% albedo, water-ice composition) — its real double-lobed (contact-binary) shape is not modeled, this is a sphere mesh.
